parole.significato: hartebeest (Alcelaphus buselaphus); a large African antelope with a long, narrow head and curved, ringed horns
parole.testo: Borrowed from Dutch hartebeest (“hartebeest”), formed from Dutch hart (“hart, deer”), an alternative form of hert (“deer”), + beest (“animal, beast”), literally “deer beast”.
